customSections.label: HSD Uses a Two-Day Opening Schedule
customSections.content: HSD does not start every grade on the same day. Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 begin August 31, while kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10–12 begin September 1. August 25 is Family Connections and Transitions, not the first regular day of classes.

customSections.content: Quarter and semester end dates are regular school days in HSD. When students are off the following day for grading or staff work, that date is listed separately in the calendar above.

customSections.label: Thanksgiving-Week No-School Days and June Make-Up Dates
customSections.content: Two parts of HSD's calendar need extra context: the no-school days around Thanksgiving and the possible make-up days after the scheduled last day of school.

groups.label: Thanksgiving-week no-school dates
items: Students do not attend November 22–26. The dates cover staff development and conference preparation, Family Conference Connections, Thanksgiving, and a licensed non-contract day. Students return Monday, November 29.

groups.label: Scheduled last day of school
items: June 8 is the scheduled last day for grades K–11, with early release. June 9 is the last day for licensed staff and is not a student attendance day.

groups.label: Possible make-up days
items: June 12–13 become school days only if HSD adds them to the calendar after an inclement-weather closure. HSD states that graduation dates would not be affected.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 start August 31, one day earlier than the September 1 opening in 2026–27. The all-student opening is September 1 instead of September 2.
Family Conference Connections are November 23–24, one day earlier than the November 24–25 dates in 2026–27.
The scheduled K–11 last day is June 8, two days earlier than last year. Possible weather make-up days are June 12–13 instead of June 14–15.
HSD still schedules 173 student days, with the same 88-day first semester and 85-day second semester.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Hillsboro School District start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 start Tuesday, August 31, 2027. Kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10–12 start Wednesday, September 1.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the HSD 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: HSD lists 173 student days: 88 in the first semester and 85 in the second semester.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Hillsboro students off for Thanksgiving in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Students do not attend November 22–26 for staff development and conference preparation, Family Conference Connections, Thanksgiving, and a licensed non-contract day. Students return Monday, November 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is winter break in Hillsboro School District for 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. Students return Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is spring break in Hillsboro School District in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 20–24, 2028. Students return Monday, March 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in Hillsboro School District in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: June 8, 2028, is the scheduled last day for grades K–11, with early release. June 12–13 are possible make-up days if HSD needs them after an inclement-weather closure.

sourceReviewSummary: Last checked August 9, 2026. We verified the dates on this page against HSD's revised 2027–28 district calendar PDF and checked the district calendar page for the published English and Spanish calendar links.
sourceReviewDetails: We reviewed HSD's official one-page PDF visually because the calendar uses color to distinguish first days, grading-period endings, early-release days, no-school days, and Family Connections and Transitions. HSD's calendar page labels it adopted May 26, 2026, while the linked PDF is marked revised June 25, 2026.

The revised PDF contains an internal mismatch for Semester 1. Its student-day summary lists 88 days, while the January 27 annotation says ‘End of 1st Semester (90).’ This page uses 88 because that is the PDF's stated Semester 1 total. With 50 days shown for Quarter 1, Quarter 2 is therefore 38 days.

The June 12–13 make-up note carries over a reference to the 2026–27 school year. Because those dates appear in June 2028 on HSD's 2027–28 calendar, this page lists them as conditional 2027–28 make-up dates while preserving HSD's warning that they are used only if needed.
We recheck the page if HSD publishes another revision or announces that a June make-up day will be used.
